# Hash-pinned dependency set for the image-scan offline migration test; every
# package is pinned to an exact version with SHA-256 hashes and installed with
# pip --require-hashes.
#
# Regenerate after bumping pytest:
#   echo 'pytest==<version>' \
#     | uv pip compile - --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#       --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --exclude-newer '3 days' \
#       --no-annotate --no-header -o .github/scripts/image-scan-requirements.txt
